correctness.rationale: Connected-Laplacian conservation forces equal per-vertex firing count in any return after three steps; excluding 0/3 leaves one fire or two fires per vertex. The degree-bounded nontrivial periodic strip and involution x_v -> 2deg(v)-1-x_v exchange these classes, reflecting total mass about 7n+2. In the once-fire class, two hubs must have distinct phases. For ordered hub phases (0,1), k leaves firing at phase 1 carry one initial chip each and others zero; the phase-1 hub carries exactly n chips and the phase-0 hub has n+1,...,2n-k chips. Hence each chosen k-subset yields one state at every mass 2n+1+k,...,3n, and six distinct ordered hub phases give cumulative binomial coefficients. Summing (n-k)binom(n,k)=n2^(n-1), doubling by complement, and dividing into length-3 orbits yields 6n2^n states and 2n2^n orbits. K_{2,n} excludes period three by Jiang Theorem 3.10. Size bias gives K~Bin(n-1,1/2) and conditional uniform slack; their normalized limit, with complement, gives the mixture of uniforms. Independently implemented literal synchronous update with finite bounded boxes n=2,3,4,5 checked respectively 576,4096,25600,147456 initial configurations and each mass coefficient, agreeing with formula. These finite experiments are corroboration, not proof for all n. No mathematical counterexample found.
residual_risks: Independent brute-force tests cover only n=2..5; all n requires symbolic phase argument, which was independently reconstructed.
Proof does not extend to attraction basins or periods other than three; none is claimed.
